name: Second Site
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach A Teia: IP Recovery, The Automata Initiative's Jinteki identity, which keeps to two remote servers and installs a second card free in the other the first time each turn. A Thousand Cuts' frame under a new identity (The Automata Initiative Stage 8c). Parhelion Stage 3b: two Simulation Reset for two of its three Mindscaping. Uprising Stage 6: two Engram Flush for Urtica Cipher and Retribution, a card type chosen on encounter and the grip revealed. Downfall Stage 5: two Public Health Portal for two Esca, an asset that shows the top of R&D and pays 2[credit] each turn; Esca is in another deck. Reprints Stage 3: two Ronin for its two Public Health Portal, still in Open Book, and two Celebrity Gift for its two Cultivate, still in Nuvem SA's tournament list.
